targets.rawSql:
WITH station_data AS (

    SELECT 'l1_buffer_a' AS station_name,
        time, value, mean, any_violation,
        upper_3sigma, lower_3sigma,
        violated_rules
    FROM l1_buffer_a_cycle_nelson_view
    WHERE time BETWEEN
          to_timestamp(${anomaly_time}::bigint / 1000.0) - INTERVAL '30 seconds'
      AND to_timestamp(${anomaly_time}::bigint / 1000.0) + INTERVAL '30 seconds'

    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'l1_buffer_b',
        time, value, mean, any_violation,
        upper_3sigma, lower_3sigma,
        violated_rules
    FROM l1_buffer_b_cycle_nelson_view
    WHERE time BETWEEN
          to_timestamp(${anomaly_time}::bigint / 1000.0) - INTERVAL '30 seconds'
      AND to_timestamp(${anomaly_time}::bigint / 1000.0) + INTERVAL '30 seconds'

    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'l2_buffer_a',
        time, value, mean, any_violation,
        upper_3sigma, lower_3sigma,
        violated_rules
    FROM l2_buffer_a_cycle_nelson_view
    WHERE time BETWEEN
          to_timestamp(${anomaly_time}::bigint / 1000.0) - INTERVAL '30 seconds'
      AND to_timestamp(${anomaly_time}::bigint / 1000.0) + INTERVAL '30 seconds'

    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'l2_buffer_b',
        time, value, mean, any_violation,
        upper_3sigma, lower_3sigma,
        violated_rules
    FROM l2_buffer_b_cycle_nelson_view
    WHERE time BETWEEN
          to_timestamp(${anomaly_time}::bigint / 1000.0) - INTERVAL '30 seconds'
      AND to_timestamp(${anomaly_time}::bigint / 1000.0) + INTERVAL '30 seconds'

    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'shuttle_station',
        time, value, mean, any_violation,
        upper_3sigma, lower_3sigma,
        violated_rules
    FROM shuttle_cycle_nelson_view
    WHERE time BETWEEN
          to_timestamp(${anomaly_time}::bigint / 1000.0) - INTERVAL '30 seconds'
      AND to_timestamp(${anomaly_time}::bigint / 1000.0) + INTERVAL '30 seconds'

    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'l1_dispenser',
        time, value, mean, any_violation,
        upper_3sigma, lower_3sigma,
        rule_description AS violated_rules
    FROM l1_dispenser_cycle_nelson_view
    WHERE time BETWEEN
          to_timestamp(${anomaly_time}::bigint / 1000.0) - INTERVAL '30 seconds'
      AND to_timestamp(${anomaly_time}::bigint / 1000.0) + INTERVAL '30 seconds'

    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'l2_dispenser',
        time, value, mean, any_violation,
        upper_3sigma, lower_3sigma,
        rule_description AS violated_rules
    FROM l2_dispenser_cycle_nelson_view
    WHERE time BETWEEN
          to_timestamp(${anomaly_time}::bigint / 1000.0) - INTERVAL '30 seconds'
      AND to_timestamp(${anomaly_time}::bigint / 1000.0) + INTERVAL '30 seconds'

    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'l1_inspection',
        time, value, mean,
        (anomaly_point IS NOT NULL) AS any_violation,
        upper_3sigma, lower_3sigma,
        violated_rules
    FROM l1_inspection_cycle_nelson_view
    WHERE time BETWEEN
          to_timestamp(${anomaly_time}::bigint / 1000.0) - INTERVAL '30 seconds'
      AND to_timestamp(${anomaly_time}::bigint / 1000.0) + INTERVAL '30 seconds'

    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'l2_inspection',
        time, value, mean,
        (anomaly_point IS NOT NULL) AS any_violation,
        upper_3sigma, lower_3sigma,
        violated_rules
    FROM l2_inspection_cycle_nelson_view
    WHERE time BETWEEN
          to_timestamp(${anomaly_time}::bigint / 1000.0) - INTERVAL '30 seconds'
      AND to_timestamp(${anomaly_time}::bigint / 1000.0) + INTERVAL '30 seconds'
)

SELECT
    station_name,
    value,
    time,
    mean,
    upper_3sigma AS ucl,
    lower_3sigma AS lcl,
    CASE
        WHEN any_violation THEN 'ANOMALY'
        ELSE 'NORMAL'
    END AS status,
    violated_rules
FROM station_data
ORDER BY value DESC;
